newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis says France, Germany on same growth path.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis says France, Germany on same growth path.

text.p: France and Germany are on the same growth path, which should "inspire confidence," French finance minister Jean Arthuis said on Thursday.
"Our economies are on the same growth trend, a trend which should inspire confidence", he said after a lunch with Prime Minister Alain Juppe.

"What is clear is in the first half, we had growth of 0.7 percent and the Germans are on the same level," he said. "The Germans have said their growth for 1996 will be revised higher but their forecast was lower than ours."
French gross domestic product (GDP) shrank 0.4 percent in the second quarter from the first quarter, at the top end of economists' forecasts.
